desc: Build adjacency lists containing both directions of every constraint, including self-loops and parallel edges.
Traverse every component iteratively, assign XOR potentials, and detect all inconsistencies.
For each component, choose the offset minimizing the sum independently for every relevant bit.
Construct values for all vertices, including isolated vertices, and output `-1` when inconsistent.
Ensure linear time and iterative memory-safe implementation for the given limits.
